sequence.note: 1. e4 - Claim control of the center and open lines for queen and bishop.
2. Nf3 - Develop knight with an attack on Black's e5 pawn.
3. Bc4 - The Italian Game! Target Black's vulnerable f7 square.
4. c3 - Prepare central expansion with d4.
5. d3 - Solidify the center and prepare kingside castling.
